{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline and biomarker_final
sentinel_values = [-999.0, -999, np.nan, None]

# Check baseline
baseline_sentinel_count = data['biomarker_baseline'].isin(sentinel_values).sum()
print(f"Baseline sentinel count: {baseline_sentinel_count}")

# Check final
final_sentinel_count = data['biomarker_final'].isin(sentinel_values).sum()
print(f"Final sentinel count: {final_sentinel_count}")

# Check if any baseline is zero (would cause division by zero in % change)
zero_baseline = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == 0).sum()
print(f"Zero baseline count: {zero_baseline}")

# Check if baseline and final are in the same units (same scale?)
print(f"Baseline range: {data['biomarker_baseline'].min():.1f} to {data['biomarker_baseline'].max():.1f}")
print(f"Final range: {data['biomarker_final'].min():.1f} to {data['biomarker_final'].max():.1f}")"}
